issue.description:
Parent: the R041 umbrella (agent-friction:umbrella). Implements R041 decision 3 as specified by the spec child. Evidence is on the umbrella.

Problem: `--notes` replaces, so agents append by hand: read the old notes, concatenate, write back. That happened 1,132 times inside a single command, plus ~90 times via raw sqlite3. It races with concurrent writers, and an operator once destroyed a worker's investigation this way. Long text travels as `"$(cat file)"` (2,384 calls). Text beginning with `-` or `---` (a common separator in agent notes) is rejected as an unknown flag.

Scope:
- `update --append-notes TEXT` appends inside the mutation transaction.
- `--notes-file PATH`, with `-` meaning stdin; `close --reason-file PATH|-`; `create --description-file PATH|-`.
- Values beginning with `-` are accepted for --notes, --append-notes, --reason, --description and --title.
- Help examples show the append and file forms.

Acceptance:
- Two concurrent appenders on separate connections both survive (deterministic two-connection test); --append-notes honours --if-revision and the claim credential.
- File and stdin input behave identically to the inline flags. More than one notes source in a call is a usage error (exit 2).
- `--notes "--- re-verify"` and `--reason "- item"` are stored verbatim.
- Secret scanning (ADR-020) applies identically to appended, file-sourced and stdin-sourced text: a blocked secret in an appended note rejects the whole mutation and stores nothing.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test pass.
issue.notes: Implemented and delivered in commits 358a11d3 and 8814f382. Added atomic transactional --append-notes with revision and claim fencing, file/stdin text transports, source exclusivity, leading-hyphen values, scanner parity, help examples, and deterministic concurrency/rollback coverage in tests/r041_text_inputs.rs. Pre-delivery status confirmed unrelated worker edits were not staged. Fresh git archive extraction /var/tmp/bead-rs-final-U1pGUT passed scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast, cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test after rerunning with a clean TMPDIR; all tests passed. Initial explicit cargo test with inherited TMPDIR failed only the repository Git-environment guard and was rerun successfully with clean TMPDIR. Pushed to origin/main; git rev-list origin/main..HEAD is empty.

issue.description:
Umbrella for plan requirement R041. Closes when every child is closed and the release child has recorded the post-release measurement against the baseline below.

Evidence baseline (2026-10-15, bead 0.3.0 on codinghome). Source: every bead invocation in agent transcripts under ~/.claude/projects (59,115 calls, 9,175 Claude Code sessions) and ~/.codex/sessions (78,249 calls, 16,861 Codex sessions), Aug-Oct 2026. Counts are regex-based and approximate; Codex failure counts are understated because failures were detected from exit-code text.

- show --json: 14,266 of 26,607 calls carry an unwrap workaround (`.[0]`, `isinstance(d, list)`); hundreds failed outright with `list indices must be integers` or `jq: Cannot index array with string "status"`.
- list --json: 1,587 calls died on `JSONDecodeError: Extra data`; 2,536 needed `jq -s` or a per-line loop. An empty result prints `[]` while a non-empty one prints one object per line (verified in FABRIC 2026-10-15), so no single parser handles both.
- create --json: attempted 189 times; unsupported.
- Claim credential: 5,216 mutations rejected with `Claim-epoch credential required`; 4,248 succeeded on exactly one retry (pure round-trip waste); 760 were not recovered within the next 15 calls. 7,646 show calls existed only to extract claim_epoch, some guessing field names (`.claim_epoch // .claimFencingToken // .fencing_token`); ~30 passed an empty `--fencing-token ''`. 109 `unexpected argument '--fencing-token'` on label add/remove. NEEDLE already exports NEEDLE_BEAD_ID and NEEDLE_BEAD_FENCING_TOKEN to every claimed dispatch (NEEDLE eaf92d3a, 2026-09-14) but only 77 of ~15,000 fenced commands used the variable.
- Notes: 15,972 `update --notes` calls; 1,132 read-modify-write the old notes inside the same command; 2,384 pass `"$(cat file)"`; ~90 read notes via raw sqlite3. Text beginning with `-` or `---` is rejected as an unknown flag (reproduced: `error: unexpected argument '--- re-verify' found`).
- Missing commands agents reach for: `list | grep` 4,319 and `bead search` 844; `bead ready` 261; `dep list|tree` 256; bare `bead <ID>` 90; `list --all` dozens; `history|events|log` ~30; positional `label add ID LABEL` ~60 errors.
- 1,335 commands bypass the CLI with sqlite3 on .beads/beads.db (notes, claim_epoch, events, dependencies, GROUP BY counts); 9 wrote to bead tables.
- 6,209 of 26,036 sessions (24%) stopped to read `bead ... --help`; most-read: update, list, close, create, show.

Children (all blocking this bead):
- spec: specify the R041 surface (blocks every implementation child)
- json-documents: one JSON document from list/show/create --json
- claim-credential: NEEDLE_BEAD_FENCING_TOKEN + --fencing-token on every mutation
- text-input: --append-notes, file/stdin input, hyphen-leading values
- read-shortcuts: ready, search, list --all/--search/--count, dep list, bare ID
- history: bead history ID
- positional-labels: label add|remove ID LABEL...
- release: release to codinghome + lab and measure against this baseline

Deliberately out of scope: editable title/description/priority. R037/ADR-007 fix those at create. The evidence (44 `update --title|--description|--priority` attempts, one agent writing `UPDATE issues SET title` straight into SQLite) goes to the plan's Open questions via the spec child, for the plan owner to decide.
